budget_semantics: 100 controls per episode and3200total are maxima; original success terminates early. No padded/repeated controls or replacement episodes.
128MiB is the total proposed raw collection artifact cap (NPZ+JSON and bounded publication overhead), not a claim that RGB payload alone is128MiB. Full-length RGB payload is89,358,336bytes.
The existing source32MiB per-run writer caps published contents; temporary manifest/file accounting and aggregate128MiB enforcement must be reviewed before any future collection.
120s per run/480s total is a fixed proposed collection wall budget. No extension, resume, extra run, automatic recollection or data-dependent seed search.

coverage.contact: Unproven; measure train and development only after authorized collection.
coverage.failure_policy: Poor contact/rotation/near-success coverage is reported as a gap. No automatic extra reset candidates, new run, recollection, split reassignment or held-test inspection.
coverage.near_success: Unproven; reset_issues excludes initial coverage>.90, and source termination/cutoffs may reduce examples.

future_start_gates: Separate explicit collection authorization and reviewed path/aggregate quotas.
Implement/review exact reviewed-state and cross-run scene exclusion without enlarging the fixed reset budget.
Resolve current all-split collector/catalog readback before preserving held model_test access restrictions.
After whole-episode source freeze, bind exact manifests/catalogs and keep runA/runB validation roles fixed.
Train T/L plus genuinely independent validation T/L must have complete present >=4-control windows; otherwise real adaptation start is rejected.

held_payload_policy.allowed: Catalog/manifest identity and stat only; no held JSON/NPZ payload loading, coverage computation or tuning.
current_source_gaps: collect_official_play.py calls validate_official_dataset after finish, which loads every episode including model_test.
training_data.write_catalog also loads every episode to derive scene hashes.
held_payload_policy.required_future_resolution: Do not invoke these all-split readback paths under the current preparation policy. Future collection/catalog freezing needs reviewed metadata/in-memory identity capture and held manifest/stat-only handling, or separate explicit integrity-read authority.

reviewed_scene_exclusion.definition: SHA256(dataset.json_bytes(asdict(initial Snapshot))) matches existing source catalog initial_state_sha256.
reviewed_scene_exclusion.limitation: Current collector rejects unsafe/near-goal states and explicit integer seeds, but has no reviewed-state hash filter. A future source change/review is required; this plan does not claim the filter already runs.
reviewed_scene_exclusion.required_gate: Before the first recorded control, reject any exact reviewed full-state hash or within-plan repeated initial scene within the same fixed20-candidate budget; persist all spent resets. Cross-split duplicates found at freeze stop the plan, with no reassignment or recollection.

scene_and_episode_identity.reason: Source trajectory ID hashes collector version, geometry hash, physics hash, actual accepted reset seed, derived action seed, steps and waypoint settings. Actual accepted scene/physics is not simulated in preparation.
scene_and_episode_identity.source_split: freeze_splits sorts SHA256(f"{master_seed}:{trajectory_id}") and allocates whole episodes80/10/10 =>6/1/1 for8. Do not choose episode indices or move short/undesirable episodes after seeing coverage.
scene_and_episode_identity.validation_policy: RunA source validation is development; runB source validation is independent_validation, subject to actual scene/provenance checks. Held source model_test stays held.

seed_checks.caveat: Disjoint integer seeds do not prove disjoint physical scenes or coverage. Actual accepted reset and controller states are unknown until separately authorized collection.
